verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board provides stronger tinted phase grouping but loses finish through long looping cache routes, uneven density, and visibly truncated or raw-markup annotations.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The five regions occupy most of the inner frame, but the low outcomes band and the large unused exterior margins make the composition feel slightly undersized and bottom-heavy.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have ample breathing room, though the task-execution/cache boundary becomes busy where the ready-tasks, lookup-key, and check corridors converge.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct blue, purple, orange, teal, and green tinted regions clearly organize the numbered phases and do genuine structural work.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Flow-family hues are consistent and failure/success colors are immediately legible, although yellow annotation cards recur across unrelated sections and slightly weaken semantic specificity.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair waypoints are exposed, but several arrowheads terminate on region boundaries or long routed runs, and raw bold markers plus truncated text in the safety and failure notes visibly leak unfinished craft.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Section headers and major columns register cleanly, but the sparse first two phases contrast abruptly with the dense execution/cache cluster and the outcomes row does not align naturally with the upper columns.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local vertical flows are clear, but multiple green cache/success wires make large perimeter-like loops around the lower-right board, run close together, and obscure the return-path hierarchy.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness (7.5) ranks first, intent-classification-2 (7.0) second, and the board under grade (6.5) third.
